feature_name: Bulk version deletion in project history
summary: Bulk version deletion in project history lets users delete multiple unused script versions at once.
extended_definition: Bulk version deletion in project history lets users delete multiple unused script versions at once.

supporting_pages.title: Google Apps Script release notes \_|\_ Google for Developers
evidence_snippets: December 06, 2023 Feature ( Generally available ): You can now delete versions in your Apps Script project from the project history page in the Apps Script IDE.
March 07, 2024 Feature (Generally Available) : You can now delete multiple unused versions at the same time from the Project History page.

To learn more, refer to the following: Google Workspace Updates blog : View & compare script versions with Apps Script project history Developer documentation : Versions June 12, 2023 Feature Third-party smart chips and link previews are now generally available.
